Share capital: Authorized shares saved on focus change and Issued shares on Enter; Escape abandoned an edit; -5 and 12.5 were refused with the saved value kept; a blank Issued shares saved as blank; Par value stayed unavailable until a Currency was chosen, 1.25 GBP saved, 1.255 was refused with "Enter a non-negative amount with up to 2 decimal places.", and changing to EUR kept 1.25; the legacy par value showed 125 with the stored-minor-units note and Confirm par value currency / Confirm amount and currency saved it. Share register: "No share register yet"; New share class saved Ordinary (1,000 authorized, 1 vote per share) and Preference (no cap); a second Ordinary was refused ("A share class named Ordinary already exists on this Entity."). Record entry offered Allotment, Transfer, Buyback, Cancellation and Conversion with Effective date on today; Entity from the registry left out the Entity itself and the archived Entity; Allotments to an Entity and to a New individual, Transfers with certificates cancelled and issued, a Buyback into Treasury and a Cancellation from "Treasury (shares the company holds)" wrote the Register of allotments and transfers and the Register of members; an entry below zero was refused ("Entry 5 would take a holder's balance below zero."); over-allotment warned "1,300 Ordinary shares are issued against 1,000 authorized."; "Remove entry 5" asked "Remove entry 005 from the register?" and the number was not reused; "Edit entry 2" opened "Edit entry 002" and saved. Register as of, Previous and Next entry date, Reset to today, the Change to today column, Filter by Entry, Export register and Export (CSV) worked; the line read "Today the register does not agree with Share capital. The Overview declares 1,000 issued; the register sums to 900." and then "... agrees ...: 900 issued.". Register Holdings replaced the hand-typed Entity owner, kept the hand-typed individual, and showed From register (no percent or remove control) on the owner. Chart: 75% and 40% primary solid, 25% and 35% dashed, register edges 55.56% and 33.33%, the individual owner with a person icon and the label Individual opening the Entity's Ownership tab, the unconnected Entity in its own row; drag, wheel, arrow keys, plus, zero, Fit to window, click/Space highlight, Clear highlight/Escape and double-click/Enter worked. Priya Raman saw 53 Contracts and 2 Matters with matching nav counts and got 404 for the Confidential ones. Grants: Nadia Haddad without a Grant saw the switch disabled and no Manage access; Manage access > Confidential access > Person > Grant access listed Daniel Okafor and Priya Raman (29 people offered, no Business Users); the Confidential switch saved; Priya opened the Entity; Nadia (no Grant) got 404, Holdings and the register showed Restricted Entity, the chart a Confidential Entity box, and her edit of a register entry naming the Holder was refused with "This entry names an Entity you cannot see. limitations: Independent agent walkthrough in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.63.0) by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The main Contracts and Matters lists show each reader's own saved layout, so "the same columns as the main list" was checked on the Columns menu: the tab's menu offers the same column set as the main list's menu. For the Administrator the shown headers were also identical; for the Legal Team Member her main Contracts list had a saved six-column layout while the tab showed the default columns.
Author limitation confirmed: Columns changes on the tab last for the visit only; after a reload the tab showed its default columns again.

A detached Entity Field has no control on the Matter, and the API refused a write that cleared the detached value. The link was removed by attaching the Field again and clearing the value, which the guide's "until that value is cleared" allows but does not describe.

Observations carried from DOC-030 and seen again: share register entry rows show Edit and Remove as two icon buttons rather than a row menu; the reconciliation line reports agreement when Issued shares is blank (the guide says so); a hand-typed owner is still accepted on an Entity that keeps a register (the guide says so). They are recorded as observations in walkthrough.json.
Some page loads showed the app's "Something went wrong." screen on the busy shared lab; the script reloaded and the step passed. Occurrences are recorded in walkthrough.json.
